items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I wonder how did Eileen and Norman Selby happen to get you? [INTERVIEWEE] Through Sid Catlett

ctx.x: Man, I digged that boy and cats was kind of half sulking with me. (LAUGHTER). They didn't want me to even look at her.
I wonder how did Eileen and Norman Selby happen to get you?
